claims: The 2026 Chicago St. Patrick's Day celebrations take place the weekend of March 14-15.
The Chicago River is dyed green at 10 a.m. on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The downtown parade follows the Chicago River dyeing.
The 48th Annual South Side Irish Parade occurs on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 48th Annual South Side Irish Parade occurs on Western Avenue.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade occurs on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade generally starts around noon.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade typically moves along Columbus Drive.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade starts at Balbo and Columbus.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade proceeds north.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade features Shannon Rovers Irish Pipe Band.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade features marching bands.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade features floats.
The Downtown Chicago St. Patrick's Day Parade features step dancers.
The South Side Irish Parade occurs at 12:00 PM on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The South Side Irish Parade steps off at 103rd and Western Avenue.
The South Side Irish Parade marches south to 115th Street.
The South Side Irish Parade features local pipe bands.
The South Side Irish Parade features marching bands.
The South Side Irish Parade features floats.
The South Side Irish Parade is known as one of the largest community Irish parades outside Dublin.
The Northwest Side Irish Parade celebrates its 22nd year the weekend of March 14-15, 2026.
The Archer Ave. St. Patrick’s Day Parade takes place the weekend of March 14-15, 2026.
Parking is limited for all events.
Street closures are extensive for all events.
Street closures are particularly extensive in the Beverly neighborhood on Sunday.
